_notes: Named rares of Northern Tanaris and the Drownbell's boss and rare. One item per kill. Hand-authored in tools/build_tanaris_content.py; spread checked by its audit().

Thaka the Unburied.name: Thaka's Grave-Haft
Thaka the Unburied.flavor_text: Troll iron, buried with him, dug back up by him.

Thaka the Unburied.name: Unburied Pauldrons
Thaka the Unburied.flavor_text: Sand came out of the seams for a week.

Thaka the Unburied.name: Sandfury Ritual Wraps
Thaka the Unburied.flavor_text: Whatever was done at that pyramid, it was done with hands like these.

Thaka the Unburied.name: Pyramid-Step Treads
Thaka the Unburied.flavor_text: The steps are still there. That is most of what is left.

The Last Tenant.name: The Tenant's Ledger
The Last Tenant.flavor_text: It nested in a counting house and chewed a nest out of the books. This one survived.

The Last Tenant.name: Hoarded Scrap Vest
The Last Tenant.flavor_text: Goblin plate, chewed into a shape that suited something else.

The Last Tenant.name: Lintel-Fall Girdle
The Last Tenant.flavor_text: Taken from under a doorway that is still standing, which is more than can be said for the door.

The Last Tenant.name: Empty-City Mantle
The Last Tenant.flavor_text: Nobody locked anything. They just went.

Nineteen Mile.name: Milepost Breaker
Nineteen Mile.flavor_text: Named for the stone it uprooted and carried for a season.

Nineteen Mile.name: Nineteen-Mile Hide
Nineteen Mile.flavor_text: Road dust worked so far in it is part of the hide.

Nineteen Mile.name: Drover's Vigil Bracers
Nineteen Mile.flavor_text: You hear it on the road long before the road shows you anything.

Nineteen Mile.name: Roadwatch Pendant
Nineteen Mile.flavor_text: Carried by somebody who counted the posts out loud to stay awake.

Marrowmaw.name: Marrowmaw's Rib-Hook
Marrowmaw.flavor_text: Not a tooth. Something it found and kept using.

Marrowmaw.name: Bonefield Jerkin
Marrowmaw.flavor_text: There is a smell in the bonefields and this has it.

Marrowmaw.name: Hyena-Laugh Helm
Marrowmaw.flavor_text: You hear them before dark and then you hear them all night.

Marrowmaw.name: Carrion-Watch Leggings
Marrowmaw.flavor_text: Whatever stops on that road is theirs by morning.

Saltjaw.name: Saltjaw's Spine-Rod
Saltjaw.flavor_text: Brine got into it and did something nobody has explained.

Saltjaw.name: Brine-Crusted Hauberk
Saltjaw.flavor_text: Rinse it and it comes away in your hand. Nobody rinses it.

Saltjaw.name: Shorebreaker Gauntlets
Saltjaw.flavor_text: It works the tideline where the sand stops being sand.

Saltjaw.name: Tidewrack Shoulderpads
Saltjaw.flavor_text: Everything the sea gives back, it gives back here.

The Drowned Purser.name: The Purser's Tally-Staff
The Drowned Purser.flavor_text: Still counting. That is the part people find difficult.

The Drowned Purser.name: Short-Measure Wraps
The Drowned Purser.flavor_text: He was thrown over for exactly what you think.

The Drowned Purser.name: Ledger-Keeper's Jerkin
The Drowned Purser.flavor_text: The book went in with him and the book is not in the pockets.

The Drowned Purser.name: Drowned Purser's Signet
The Drowned Purser.flavor_text: It has a number on the inside and the number is not a date.

The Bellwarden.name: The Warden's Chain-Axe
The Bellwarden.flavor_text: A length of the bell's own chain with something heavy wired to the end of it.

The Bellwarden.name: Careenage Scale Greaves
The Bellwarden.flavor_text: They hauled hulls over on this ground for years before anybody took the cove.

The Bellwarden.name: Bellwarden's Breastplate
The Bellwarden.flavor_text: Whatever it is guarding, it was not told to stop.

The Bellwarden.name: Chain-Rust Band
The Bellwarden.flavor_text: Salt water and iron, given a very long time.

Captain Vaile Drownbell.name: Vaile's Cutlass
Captain Vaile Drownbell.flavor_text: She took this cove off people who were only trying to lift something out of it.

Captain Vaile Drownbell.name: Drownbell's Longcoat
Captain Vaile Drownbell.flavor_text: Dry on the inside, which down there is a kind of wealth.

Captain Vaile Drownbell.name: Captain's Storm-Hood
Captain Vaile Drownbell.flavor_text: She does not go down to the bell either.

Captain Vaile Drownbell.name: Cove-Taker's Spaulders
Captain Vaile Drownbell.flavor_text: Two of them went down to look at it. Neither came back up.
